item.title: The Importance of Flexibility in Fire Department Leadership
item.description: John J. Salka Jr. tells fire department officers why they must be prepared to adjust their supervisory skills for the inevitable circumstance in which they are responsible for members who aren’t part of their everyday crew.

item.title: CT Lawmakers Nix Change to Allow Single Stairwells in Small Apartment Buildings
item.description: Fire marshals and chiefs across Connecticut opposed single stairwells saying it would put residents and firefighters at risk.

item.title: The Firehouse Yak: Flip Griffin – Flipping Fire Service Leadership
item.description: Peter Matthews talks with U.S. Navy Command Master Chief (ret.) Flip Griffin about the impact of leadership on fire service recruitment, retention and burnout and how departments can work to change those problems.

item.title: Hiram, OH, Mayor Shuts Down Fire Department after Chief Retires
item.description: The Hiram Firefighters Association lauded Fire Chief Bill Byers for his leadership and dedication to the department.

item.title: Ex-Hygiene, CO, Fire Captain Gets Prison for Sexually Assaulting Women
item.description: The five victims told the judge that the former Hygiene fire captain's actions have impacted their lives forever.

item.title: Nevada State Fire Marshal Fired After DUI Arrest
item.description: Joseph Rodriquez was named Nevada State Fire Marshal in October after serving with the agency since 2016.

item.title: Watch: Two Rescued after Hot Air Balloon Hits Tower in Gregg County, TX
item.description: High-angle rescue teams from Longview and other agencies worked together during the operation.

item.title: Impromptu Visit in Wichita, KS, for Son of Injured Firefighter Goes Viral
item.description: "This is what brotherhood is all about. It's what we do," Wichita Lt. Josh Griffin said.

item.title: Ambulance Flips in Crash with SUV in Holly Springs, NC
item.description: The Wake County ambulance was responding to an emergency when the collision occurred.

item.title: Loveland, CO, Fire Rescue Chief Refutes Board's Claims of Wrongdoings
item.description: “Differences in interpretation or perception should not be conflated with intentional misconduct or an effort to divide," Loveland Fire Chief Tim Sendelbach wrote in a 40-page letter to the board.
